get.description: The marketplace. In the live workspace: every pack definition, `installed` for the caller's org.

One pack. `inputSchema` is the JSON Schema of the input a run takes: for every pack in the live
workspace, and in the demo workspace for a pack that runs for real (the runtime is on and it has a
definition). `maxBudget` is the most one run may be given (422 BUDGET_TOO_HIGH above it): on every live
pack that sets one, and on the demo detail of a pack that runs for real.
Functions and industries packs are classified by (the `taxonomy` definition).
Agents in the catalog: definition agents first, then (demo workspace only) sample agents.

post.description:
Keyword match for the static API. The dynamic backend asks Gemini and keeps this response shape.
The live workspace matches over the pack definitions.

Move an added pack listed by another workspace to its newest approved version. Until then its runs keep
the version pinned when it was added. Live workspace only.

get.description:
Real runs (newest first, when the runtime is on), then the fixtures; the live workspace has real runs
only.

post.description:
Returns 202: the run is registered and started, not finished (API.md section 3). With the runtime on,
a pack that has a definition runs for real on Temporal; any other pack keeps the fixture behaviour. In
the live workspace every run is real: the org must have added the pack and connected its apps, the
input must match the pack's input schema and the month's spend must be below the monthly cap.

409.description: Conflict (PLATFORM_PAUSED, PACK_NOT_HIRED, APPS_NOT_CONNECTED, RUN_BUDGET_OVER_CAP, SPEND_CAP, PACK_UNAVAILABLE, CONFLICT).

get.description: The work receipt of a real run: pinned versions, entries and whether the hash chain verifies.
Approvals of real runs (newest first), then the fixtures (none in the live workspace).

In the live workspace: the caller's decided tasks of the org's runs and the network reviews they did
for other orgs, simulated (no money moves).

The signed-in user's profile as a New Machines network reviewer; not enabled until they turn it on.
Live workspace only (404 in the demo).

put.description:
Turn "Review for the network" on or off and save the profile (name, languages, skills). Turning it off
returns the open tasks the user claimed through the network to the queue. Live workspace only.

get.description:
Fixture memory, after the items of real memory spaces when the runtime is on. The live workspace has
the org's own items and the shared seed and console items only.

post.description: In the live workspace: retract one of the org's own items, so runs no longer recall it.

get.description: In the live workspace: the apps used by the packs the org added, connected or not.

post.description:
Connect an app (a connector key or app name) for the org. `mode: sandbox` (the default) connects it to
sandbox data. `mode: live` starts signing in to the org's own account: the connection is pending and
`redirectUrl` is the app's sign-in page, which returns to the web's Connections page; only an owner or
admin may, and only they may switch an app connected to the org's own account to sandbox data (403
FORBIDDEN otherwise). The demo workspace has none to make (409). An org's own MCP server is managed under
its MCP servers (409 MCP_SERVER_CONNECTION).

503.description: The connection service did not answer (CONNECTION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE).

post.description:
Live workspace: check the org's own account for an app with Composio, after the person comes back from
signing in. Connected when the account is active, with the grants of the packs that use the app; not
connected (or needing sign-in again) when the sign-in failed or expired; still pending while it is in
progress. The demo workspace has nothing to sync (409). An org's own MCP server is managed under its MCP
servers (409 MCP_SERVER_CONNECTION).

503.description: The connection service did not answer (CONNECTION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE).

post.description:
Disconnect an app: every pack the org added loses access to it. In the live workspace, an app
connected to the org's own account (mode composio, whatever its status) is only disconnected by an owner
or admin (403 FORBIDDEN otherwise); its account is removed at the connection service. An org's own MCP
server is managed under its MCP servers (409 MCP_SERVER_CONNECTION).

delete.description:
Revoke one grant: the pack (`install`) may no longer use the `capability` of the `app`. In the live
workspace only an owner or admin may (403 FORBIDDEN otherwise), and the revocation is remembered until
it is allowed again.

post.description:
Live workspace: allow a grant a person revoked again (the same `app`, `install` and `capability` as
revoking it). The revocation is forgotten, and the grant comes back when a pack the org added still uses
the capability; 404 when the org's connection holds no such revocation. Only an owner or admin may (403
FORBIDDEN otherwise). The demo workspace remembers no revocations (409).

get.description: The org's MCP servers that are not removed, with their sorted tools. Any member.

post.description:
Connect the org's own MCP server: https only, on a public address. Its tools are listed and sorted into
read (runs freely), write (asks first) and blocked (never offered), then published as a private connector
for the org's Studio packs. Owners and admins.

503.description: Tokens cannot be sealed or opened right now (SECRETS_UNAVAILABLE).

post.description: List the server's tools again; the connector gets a new version only when they changed.

503.description: Tokens cannot be sealed or opened right now (SECRETS_UNAVAILABLE).

post.description: Switch one tool off: packs can no longer use it.
Switch one tool back on. A blocked tool cannot be switched on (409 TOOL_BLOCKED).
Replace the token, once the server lists its tools with the new one.

503.description: Tokens cannot be sealed or opened right now (SECRETS_UNAVAILABLE).

delete.description:
Remove the server: its token is deleted and its connection is no longer connected. Runs already
started keep the connector version they pinned, but their calls fail.

get.description:
The signed-in user and their workspace: their own org in the live workspace, the seeded org in the
demo. `invitations` lists pending invitations to other workspaces for the user's verified email (live
workspace only).

post.description:
Join the workspace that invited the user's verified email; the user leaves their current one (an
empty workspace is deleted, any other keeps its data). 403 when the email is not verified, 404 when there
is no such pending invitation, and always 404 in the demo workspace.

parameters.name: org_id

schema.description: The org that sent the invitation.
schema.title: Org Id

parameters.description: The org that sent the invitation.

post.description:
Decline a pending invitation for the user's verified email; it is deleted. 403 when the email is not
verified, 404 when there is no such invitation, and always 404 in the demo workspace.

parameters.name: org_id

schema.description: The org that sent the invitation.
schema.title: Org Id

parameters.description: The org that sent the invitation.

get.description:
The org's reviewers (members with the reviewer capability, then pending Reviewer invitations) and
whether the org allows the New Machines reviewer network.

post.description:
Give a member the reviewer capability, or invite anyone else as a Reviewer; they accept explicitly.
Owners and admins only; 409 when the person already reviews for the org.

Remove a reviewer: a member keeps their membership without the capability, a Reviewer member leaves the
org, a pending Reviewer invitation is withdrawn. Their claimed open tasks go back to the queue. Owners and
admins only; 404 when the email is not a reviewer here.

put.description:
Allow or stop the New Machines reviewer network for the org's tasks. Turning it off returns the tasks
network reviewers claimed to the queue. Owners and admins only.

get.description: What a pack's steps can use: the agents, app tools, memory and result shapes the org may see.
The agents the org built.

post.description: Save a new agent (version 1). 422 INVALID_DEFINITION lists each problem; reviewers get 403.
Check an agent draft without saving it.

Save the draft as the next version; an unchanged draft keeps the current one. 409 VERSION_CONFLICT when
`baseVersion` is not the latest.

get.description: The Workflow Packs the org built.

post.description:
Save a new pack (version 1), listed only in the org's own marketplace as built by its team. 422
INVALID_DEFINITION lists each problem with the step it is about (`errors[].key`).

Check a pack draft without saving it. Pass `key` when the draft edits a saved pack; without it the
draft is checked as a new pack, so a saved pack's own name reads as taken.

parameters.name: key

schema.description: The org's own pack the draft edits, so its current name is not counted against it.
schema.title: Key

parameters.description: The org's own pack the draft edits, so its current name is not counted against it.

post.description:
An unsaved copy of a pack to edit in the Studio: the platform's or one the org built. Nothing is
saved until the draft is created as a new pack. 404 for a pack the org cannot see; 409 NOT_COPYABLE for
another publisher's pack, which can be added but not copied; 422 NOT_EDITABLE for a pack the Studio
cannot open.
Read a workflow.yaml as steps. Nothing is saved. 422 INVALID_YAML when it cannot be read.

Start a sandbox test run of the org's own pack (returns 202: started, not finished). It runs on sandbox
data without adding the pack and is labelled as a sandbox test. The input must match the pack's input
schema (422 INVALID_INPUT) and the budget the pack's maximum (422 BUDGET_TOO_HIGH); a pack without a
maximum needs a budget (422 BUDGET_REQUIRED). The platform pause and the monthly spend cap apply.

get.description: The pack's workflow.yaml.

post.description:
Save the draft as the next version; an unchanged draft keeps the current one. 409 VERSION_CONFLICT when
`baseVersion` is not the latest. A run already started keeps the version it pinned. A pack the org has
added keeps its connection grants in step with the save, and cannot be renamed while one of its runs is
in progress (409 RUNS_IN_PROGRESS).

get.description:
The workspace's publisher profile. `enabled` is false until an owner or admin turns publishing on.
Payout details are simulated: no money moves. Owners and admins only (403 POLICY_DENIED).

403.description: Not allowed (POLICY_DENIED: owners and admins only).

put.description: Turn publishing on, or update the profile. Owners and admins only (403 POLICY_DENIED).

403.description: Not allowed (POLICY_DENIED: owners and admins only).

delete.description:
Turn publishing off: no new submissions. Listings stay as they are; New Machines unlists them. Owners
and admins only (403 POLICY_DENIED).

403.description: Not allowed (POLICY_DENIED: owners and admins only).

post.description:
Submit the agent's saved version for the marketplace at a per-call price. Owners and admins of a
workspace with a publisher profile. The automatic checks run first: the definition checks (422 with each
problem; nothing is recorded) and a sandbox call of the agent through the agent runtime. The version waits
in `checking` until that run ends, then in `in_review` for New Machines.

409.description: Conflict (PUBLISHER_PROFILE_REQUIRED, SUBMISSION_OPEN, PLATFORM_PAUSED, SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE, SPEND_CAP, PACK_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_PUBLISHABLE, VERSION_CONFLICT).

post.description:
Submit the pack's saved version for the marketplace at a per-run price. Owners and admins of a
workspace with a publisher profile. Every agent in the pack must be the platform's or listed (422
PRIVATE_AGENTS names the agents that need to be listed first, each with where it stands: not submitted,
in review, unlisted or not approved). A pack that uses the org's own MCP server cannot be submitted (409
NOT_PUBLISHABLE). The automatic checks run the definition checks and a
sandbox test run with `input` and `budgetMinor` (a completed sandbox test of this version is reused). The
version waits in `checking` until that run ends, then in `in_review` for New Machines.

409.description: Conflict (PUBLISHER_PROFILE_REQUIRED, SUBMISSION_OPEN, PLATFORM_PAUSED, SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE, SPEND_CAP, PACK_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_PUBLISHABLE, VERSION_CONFLICT).

422.description: Invalid request (INVALID_DEFINITION, PRIVATE_AGENTS, INVALID_INPUT, BUDGET_REQUIRED, BUDGET_TOO_HIGH).

get.description:
The workspace's listings: status, the newest submission, installs, runs in the last 30 days and this
month's earnings (simulated). Owners and admins only (403 POLICY_DENIED).

403.description: Not allowed (POLICY_DENIED: owners and admins only).

get.description:
One of the workspace's listings with every submitted version, its checks and the review notes. Owners
and admins only (403 POLICY_DENIED).

403.description: Not allowed (POLICY_DENIED: owners and admins only).

get.description:
The publisher share of this month's fees and the simulated payouts of earlier months. Simulated: no
money moves. Owners and admins only (403 POLICY_DENIED).

403.description: Not allowed (POLICY_DENIED: owners and admins only).

get.description:
The live workspace lists its connector definitions with the settings Ops persisted and today's usage
(UTC); the demo workspace lists its fixture catalog.
Simulated Composio toolkit discovery, minus the ones already in the catalog.

post.description:
Simulated and deterministic: healthy unless the connector is disabled. Not available in the live
workspace, which has no health probe yet.

get.description:
Every workspace's listings, newest change first. `status=in_review` is the review queue (a version
waits for a decision); `pending`, `listed` and `unlisted` filter on the listing.

One listing: its versions with check results and sandbox run, the newest version's diff against the
approved one, the price and the ops history.

post.description: Approve the version in review: it becomes the listed version. The reason is the note the publisher sees.
Send the version in review back to the publisher with a note of what to change.
Reject the version in review, with a note the publisher sees.
Take a listed agent or pack out of every other workspace's marketplace and Studio; new runs of it stop.
List an unlisted agent or pack again at its approved version.

get.description:
The latest version of every platform definition, by kind then key. An org's own definitions are not
listed.

503.description: The runtime is off or unavailable (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE).

schema.title: Version

post.description:
Check an edit (or a new definition) against the latest published versions of everything else. Never
saves anything.
`errors` lists every problem found, including ones in other definitions. `warnings` says how many
definitions that teams built in their Studio the edit would break; it never names them.

503.description: The runtime is off or unavailable (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE).

Validate, then publish the edit as the next version; an unknown kind/key is created as version 1.
422 INVALID_DEFINITION (with `errors`) when it does not validate; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT when
`baseVersion` is sent and someone has published since; 409 NO_CHANGE when it equals the latest
version. The detail's `warnings` counts the definitions teams built that this version breaks.

Remove one item from its space. An item in an org's own space is 404, worded like an unknown item so

The reviewer workforce: the New Machines reviewer network in the live workspace, the fixture pool in
the demo.

Stop offering the reviewer tasks. In the live workspace, their open network claims return to the

Offer a suspended reviewer tasks again.

Newest first. Entries with the same timestamp keep the order they were written in, newest first.
The live workspace reads the persisted ops audit log.
A real run (any tenant) with its receipt, the hash chain verified now. 404 for fixture runs.

AddMcpServerRequest.title: AddMcpServerRequest
AddMcpServerRequest.description:
`headerName` Authorization (the default) sends `Bearer <token>`; any other header sends the token
as it is.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description:
A catalog agent. `source` is "definition" for an agent definition, "sample" for a demo fixture
agent (sample agents have no skills, tools or model profile). `used_by` lists the packs whose `agents`
name it.

AgentDraft.title: AgentDraft
AgentDraft.description: An agent as the Studio edits it. Tools are app tools that only read.

ApprovalAction.title: ApprovalAction
ApprovalAction.description:
The step a real run asks to take once approved: the app it acts on, the workflow step, and the tool
call. `mocked` is true when that call would run against sandbox data instead of the connected app.

BuilderIssue.title: BuilderIssue
BuilderIssue.description: One problem in a draft. `step` names the step it is about, when it is about one.

ConnectRequest.title: ConnectRequest
ConnectRequest.description: How to connect an app: `live` signs in to the org's own account; `sandbox` serves sandbox data.

ConnectStarted.title: ConnectStarted
ConnectStarted.description:
A connection just made or started. `redirect_url` (live only) is the app's sign-in page, which returns
to the web's Connections page with `?connected=<key>`.

DecisionRule.title: DecisionRule
DecisionRule.description: `when` is CEL over the run state; the first rule that is true picks the route.

DefinitionDetail.title: DefinitionDetail
DefinitionDetail.description:
One definition at one version. `yaml` is the main file as exported (JSON for a schema); `files` holds
the Markdown files of an agent by path relative to its folder. `body` is the same main file parsed, so a
client can read fields without a YAML parser. `refs` are the definitions this one refers to and
`used_by` those that refer to it, both computed from the latest versions. `warnings` is set on a publish
that breaks definitions teams built in their Studio: a count only, never their keys.

DefinitionIssue.title: DefinitionIssue
DefinitionIssue.description: One validation error. `kind`/`key` name the definition it was found in, which can be another one.

DefinitionRef.title: DefinitionRef
DefinitionRef.description: A pointer to another definition: its kind and key.

DefinitionSummary.title: DefinitionSummary
DefinitionSummary.description:
The latest (or a chosen) version of one definition. `name` is the body's name, else its app
(connector) or question (decision rules), else the key.

FeeItem.title: FeeItem
FeeItem.description: One listing's publisher fees in a run: the quantity charged at the unit price, and the amount.

ImportWorkflowRequest.title: ImportWorkflowRequest
ImportWorkflowRequest.description: A workflow.yaml, such as one exported from a pack.

ImportedWorkflow.title: ImportedWorkflow
ImportedWorkflow.description: The steps read from a workflow.yaml, and what could not be read.

InputField.title: InputField
InputField.description: One field of the run's start form.

ListingHistoryEntry.title: ListingHistoryEntry
ListingHistoryEntry.description: One ops action on a listing, from `ops_audit`.

MarketplaceListing.title: MarketplaceListing
MarketplaceListing.description:
Another workspace's listed agent or pack. `fee` is per run (pack) or per call (agent); 0 shows as
"No fee". `version` is the newest approved version; `installed_version` and `update_available` are set on
a pack the workspace has added.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The signed-in user and the workspace they act in.

NetworkProfile.title: NetworkProfile
NetworkProfile.description:
The signed-in user's profile as a New Machines network reviewer. `suspended`: New Machines paused
it.

NetworkProfileRequest.title: NetworkProfileRequest
NetworkProfileRequest.description:
The user's switch "Review for the network" and their profile. Entries are trimmed; repeated languages
or skills are kept once (compared without case, the first spelling kept).

OpsRunDetail.title: OpsRunDetail
OpsRunDetail.description: A real run's projection together with its work receipt (hash chain verified now).

OrgReviewer.title: OrgReviewer
OrgReviewer.description: A member with the reviewer capability, or a pending Reviewer invitation.

OrgReviewers.title: OrgReviewers
OrgReviewers.description: The org's reviewers, active first, and its switch for the New Machines reviewer network.

PackCopy.title: PackCopy
PackCopy.description: An unsaved draft of a platform pack or of the org's own, to edit and save as a new pack.

PackDraft.title: PackDraft
PackDraft.description:
A Workflow Pack as the Studio edits it: what the marketplace shows, the start form, the budget and
the steps.

Palette.title: Palette
Palette.description: What a pack's steps can use, from the registry: agents, app tools, memory and result shapes.

PendingInvitation.title: PendingInvitation
PendingInvitation.description: An invitation to another workspace, waiting for the user to accept or decline it.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable machine code (API.md section 2).

ProblemIssue.title: ProblemIssue
ProblemIssue.description: One located error inside a problem (for example a definition validation error).

PublishDefinitionRequest.title: PublishDefinitionRequest
PublishDefinitionRequest.description:
`base_version` is the latest version the edit started from (0 for a new definition). When sent, the
publish is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT if someone has published since.

PublisherEarnings.title: PublisherEarnings
PublisherEarnings.description: The publisher share of fees: this calendar month (UTC) and the simulated payouts of earlier months.

PublisherRequest.title: PublisherRequest
PublisherRequest.description: Turn publishing on, or change the profile. `payout_note` is simulated payout details.

PublisherSettings.title: PublisherSettings
PublisherSettings.description:
`enabled` is whether the workspace may submit; `profile` is absent until publishing is first turned on
and kept when it is turned off. Payout details and payouts are simulated: no money moves.

Receipt.title: Receipt
Receipt.description: A real run's hash-chained work receipt; `verified` is the chain recomputed now.

RevokedGrant.title: RevokedGrant
RevokedGrant.description:
A grant a person revoked on a connection (`DELETE /v1/grants`): recomputing the connection's grants
never brings it back until it is allowed again (`POST /v1/grants`).

RuntimeStatus.title: RuntimeStatus
RuntimeStatus.description: Reachability of the runtime's parts; carries no connection strings or secrets.

SandboxRunRequest.title: SandboxRunRequest
SandboxRunRequest.description:
The run input (checked against the pack's input schema) and an optional budget; the pack's maximum
when omitted.

SaveAgentRequest.title: SaveAgentRequest
SaveAgentRequest.description: `base_version` is the version the edit started from; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT when someone saved since.

StartRunRequest.title: StartRunRequest
StartRunRequest.description:
`input` is either the pack's input object (checked against its input JSON Schema) or free text: a
date range such as "2026-10-06..2026-10-12" or "last 7 days", or for a pack whose input is one date, a
day such as "2026-10-13" or "today".

StepDraft.title: StepDraft
StepDraft.description:
One workflow node. `config` is the node's config as the runtime reads it (strings starting with "="
are CEL); `routes` maps each outcome to the next step. A decision keeps its rules in `rules`.

StudioListing.title: StudioListing
StudioListing.description: One of the workspace's listings on its Publisher tab. Earnings are simulated.

SubmitListingRequest.title: SubmitListingRequest
SubmitListingRequest.description:
The price (per run for a pack, per call for an agent; 0 is "No fee") and, for a pack, the input and
budget of the sandbox test run the automatic checks start.

Toolkit.title: Toolkit
Toolkit.description: A Composio toolkit that can be added to the catalog (simulated discovery).

UnlockedAction.title: UnlockedAction
UnlockedAction.description:
A write the same grant also lets through (an approval's `also_unlocks`): the step, its tool and the app
it acts on. `mocked` is true when that call would run against sandbox data.

ValidateDefinitionRequest.title: ValidateDefinitionRequest
ValidateDefinitionRequest.description:
The edited main file (YAML; JSON for a schema) plus the agent's Markdown files by relative path. The
`kind` and `key` inside the YAML, when present, must equal the URL's.

ValidateDefinitionResult.title: ValidateDefinitionResult
ValidateDefinitionResult.description: `warnings`, when present, says how many definitions teams built the edit would break (never which).
